title: 浅倾角贴近
description: 丙烯画描绘轻微外倾墙上的贴墙姿态，双脚始终有清晰支撑。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Create an original acrylic illustration of a fictional adult keeping the body close on a shallow overhanging bouldering panel. The wall angle is modest, with generous red handholds and positive low footholds that let both shoes remain engaged. One elbow bends for a short reach while the opposite arm stays relaxed, and the hips turn slightly toward the supporting side. A wide side view clearly shows the small wall angle, whole adult figure, and thick continuous crash mat beneath. Use broad opaque brush marks, slate-blue structure, and warm terracotta accents. Clothing is opaque and practical. Avoid feet cutting loose, explosive moves, lettering, logos, or dramatic exposure.
